facts.name: Johnson & Johnson
sentences: Johnson & Johnson's shares moved 5% or more on 1 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 22 October 2026, when the stock rose 3.8%.
The stock is up 33.5% this year, and at $276.32 it sits 0.8% below its 52-week closing high of $278.43 from 3 September 2026.
$1,000 invested in Johnson & Johnson five years ago would be worth $1,679 today.
